en: "Only, it seems Archelon just couldn't work out where the others were."{w}{p}"Personally, I think places like Semnadoc Cathedral are suuuper suspicious, though.{w}...That archbishop is suspicious too."{w}{p}"So how about it? Would you like to take this compass and go looking for the altars of the gods?"{w}
note: Subject of the hearsay restored as Archelon (gender unknown; name repeated instead of a pronoun). Daishikyou-sama left unnamed as 'that archbishop' (no name in the line).

en: "Archelon may not look it, but even Archelon is getting on in years. So it's like, 'Now you young folks will carry on the dream!'~"{w}
note: Name repeated to avoid a pronoun for Archelon. Music note -> '~'.

en: Archelon's Voice
"AHEM, ahem! Ahh, management is such busy work!{w}I'm so busy, I just can't go searching for altars!"{w}
note: Archelon is overhearing from off-screen and fishing for sympathy; subject restored.

en: "What a shame, when I'm still in my prime!{w}Well, it's a good chance to toughen up these scrawny whelps, so I'll step aside this time!!"{w}
note: hyoroi wakazou = scrawny whelps (the party); kept the gruff force.

en: "...Um.{w}So, er, that's how things stand. What do you say?"{w}{p}"It's fine even if you don't find them. I'm giving this to you all."{w}
note: 'this' = the compass, handed over in the next row.

en: You were given the Old Compass.{w}
note: Item name furubita konpasu rendered 'Old Compass' (not in glossary; glossary has lowercase 'compass' for the generic word).

en: "Think of it as a little bonus game after saving the land, and have fun with it."{w}{p}"And if you pick up any interesting stories on your travels, come and visit me again."{w}
"I'm so glad to see you looking well."{w}
"How is your search for the altars going? The altars you haven't prayed at yet are..."{w}
note: Trails into the list rows that follow.

en: "It looks like you haven't prayed at the altar of Orses yet."{w}
note: God's -sama dropped (gods' genders unknown; no 'Lord/Lady').

en: "It looks like you haven't prayed at the altar of Sarijana yet."{w}
"It looks like you haven't prayed at the altar of Rogera yet."{w}
"It looks like you haven't prayed at the altar of Semnadoc yet."{w}
"It looks like you haven't prayed at the altar of Sinhanicol yet."{w}
"It looks like you haven't prayed at the altar of Dehain yet."{w}
"There's plenty of time, so take it slow as you search, okay?"{w}

"Bistel is at peace again today.{w}...Ufufu. The town has gotten its old liveliness back, too."{w}{p}"Did you know? There's a flower shop diagonally across from the Temple of Orses. I've loved that place ever since I was little."{w}
"It's a teeny, cute little shop, crammed wall to wall with flowers that bloom across the sea, ones you can't find anywhere in Bistel..."{w}
"With days this peaceful, would it be all right if I went back to being just a girl, for one day at least?{w}Archelon has the day off today, too... *fidget fidget*"{w}
note: sowasowa rendered as '*fidget fidget*'.

en: "Hau! Th-that's...!?{w}Isn't that my blanket? My Emperor Bird blanket!?"{w}
note: The party has brought back the blanket Costo threw away (slice 011).

en: "Haaaah... I never thought I'd see it again! I'm so glad, so truly glad..."{w}

"Actually, I don't even remember when I got it, or who gave it to me. But it's my precious blanket, the one that's been with me through thick and thin... Ahh, I'm so glad..."{w}{p}"How can I ever thank you enough... Thank you so much for finding it."{w}
"Such a tragedy must never be repeated."{w}{p}"Someone. Is anyone there?"{w}
note: She is calling for a castle soldier (who answers in 3626).

en: "This blanket is an object of great importance.{w}My very survival depends on it. Treat it with care.{w}If anyone throws it away again... I will charge them with treason."{w}
note: Mock-solemn queenly register on purpose; the soldier's '...Huh?' is the punchline. The unstated thrower rendered 'anyone'.

en: "This! This cute blanket!! I want you to tell everyone in the castle that they must never, ever throw this blanket away again!"{w}
"Y-yes, understood!"{w}
Soldier's Voice
"A-an announcement from Her Majesty the Queen! If you find some dirty old blanket, do NOT throw it away!{w}Anyone who does will be charged with treason!"{w}
note: 'dirty blanket' echoes the item name Dirty Blanket (glossary).

en: Another Soldier
note: Name box betsu no heishi no koe; 'Voice' dropped to fit the ~16-char name box ('Another Soldier's Voice' is 23). Restore if the box allows.

en: "Seriously!?"{w}
"Lady Ragnastia!"{w}
note: Speaker box is Idiot Costo.

en: "Oh. Idiot Costo."{w}
note: Glossary title 'Idiot Costo'.

en: "I hear the Impala Boss blanket has been found!"{w}
note: Impara banchou = Costo's garbled name for the Emperor Bird (he used it first in slice 011, row 3100). Rendered 'Impala Boss'; new term, keep consistent with slice 011.

en: (...It's an Emperor Bird.){w}
"Well, that's great, just great! Now I can be reinstated as Finance Minister, too! Wahaha, wahahahaha!!"{w}
note: zaimu daijin = Finance Minister (glossary describes Costo as demoted ex-head of the Administration Bureau; this line names the post as Finance Minister).

en: "That's true. ...But actually, there's one more thing I'd like to ask of you..."{w}
"Oh. I've got an idea."{w}
"Eh? What is it?"{w}
"I will reinstate you as Finance Minister."{w}
"Ohhhhhh! Yessssss!!"{w}
"But while you serve as minister, would you keep running the Kernel Shop as well?"{w}
"Whaaaaat!? But I've already mastered what things cost for the common folk!?"{w}
note: The shop was his punishment/training to learn commoners' prices.

en: "That isn't the point. Because of the Contrachio affair, domestic affairs have been badly neglected...{w}Aren't the people who come to the shop voicing complaints?"{w}{p}"I feel the hearts of the castle and the town below are starting to drift apart.{w}I hoped you could act as a go-between for us..."{w}

"Well, sure, I suppose... It's thanks to this lot that we have peace now. There must be things people had been putting up with until now."{w}{p}"But... really, my body won't hold up under that, you know?"{w}
note: koitsura = the party (Costo refers to them in front of the queen).

en: "I heard Costo is immortal!"{w}
note: She talks about him in the third person to his face; kept.

en: "Never heard of it!"{w}
"You only need to split your time half and half. In all seriousness, won't you do this for me?"{w}
"If you do it, I promise I won't call you 'Idiot Costo' anymore~"{w}
note: Music note -> '~'.

en: "That should go without saying! How rude!{w}Hmm... Let me see..........."{w}
note: atarimae desho: he should never have been called that in the first place.

en: "...In that case, assign me two aides: Bito and one other.{w}Then I suppose I can manage somehow."{w}
note: New name: Bito (romanized from bitoo). Bito ika 2-mei = Bito and two others under Bito; rendered 'Bito plus two more' to avoid a pronoun (gender unknown). | Accuracy: Bito ika 2-mei = a team of two headed by Bito (X ika N-mei counts X in the N), so two aides in all, not Bito plus two; still no pronoun for Bito.

en: "Then you'll take it on?"{w}
"...It can't be helped. There's still that military budget business, after all."{w}
note: Refers to the military-budget row that got Costo demoted (slice 008, row 2716).

en: "Yay!"{w}
"...Truth is, it's been on my mind, too. What was it called, ah... the Commerce Guild.{w}That lot have been coming by the shop a lot lately. About trade."{w}
note: shoukou kumiai = Commerce Guild (from glossary 'Commerce Guild Price Agreement').

en: "The Commerce Guild? ...Ah, that's right. I left our liaison office assigned to the Contrachio response...{w}I'm sorry, it never occurred to me..."{w}{p}"Do you have some time? I'd like to ask you a little about it..."{w}
"Yes, I don't mind.{w}...Ah, you lot. Sorry, but would you step out for a bit?"{w}{p}"What comes next is talk of state affairs.{w}Don't take it personally."{w}
note: Costo to the party.

en: "Everyone, thank you so much for the blanket."{w}
"Well then, see you at the shop."{w}
"...Zeshrom. Have you still not found a single divine relic?"{w}
note: ??? is Urna (named by Zeshrom in 3710; Nonhared, Zeshrom and slice 015 confirm).

en: "My subordinates are searching high and low as we speak. In just a few more days, you will be the ruler of this land."{w}
note: anata written as 'kijo' (female form), addressing Urna.

en: "The Holy Foundation, Contrachio, has entered its selection period, and two divine relics are already in my hands. But do not let your guard down."{w}{p}"She has countless pieces of trash to serve as her hands and feet. Even now, I hear she is issuing a 'Decree' through the priestess of Bistel."{w}
note: aitsu = Fiona (her priestess issues the Decree; 3708 names Fiona as the target). Fiona is female per glossary, so 'she'. fure = the Decree. 'Two relics already in hand' vs 'not a single one found' is in the source; kept.

en: "There is no need for concern. However many of them there may be, not one of them will ever reach a divine relic."{w}{p}"And even if one did reach a relic, my subordinates will already be there waiting, ahead of them."{w}
"I am under no obligation to humor Dehain's little games, but this is the way we must defeat Fiona. You understand that, I trust."{w}
"Of course. For us as well, this method is the most efficient one."{w}{p}"We are truly grateful that you have sided with us,{w}...Lady Urna."{w}
note: Urna-sama = 'Lady Urna' (as in slice 007).

en: "Nnnghhh...{w}Zeshrom...{w}Is Zeshrom here...!"{w}
"What is it?"{w}
"That divine relic you sent me after...{w}Someone else had already found it."{w}
"What? And then what happened?"{w}
"I figured I'd kill 'em quick and take it, but look at the state of me...{w}Damn it, I can't believe I screwed up like this..."{w}
note: karuku yatte kara itadaku: kept the killing intent at full force.

en: "Impossible. Our intel says nothing about anyone that strong...{w}What were they like?"{w}
note: dou na yatsu da, soitsu wa is singular, but Nonhared answers about a group; 'they' covers both.

en: "Nah, they looked like an ordinary bunch, but... they had some item that gives off light.{w}...I'd say it's more accurate than Urna's detection."{w}
note: The light-emitting item = the party's Old Compass. Nonhared says plain 'Urna' (no -sama); kept, Zeshrom adds 'Lady' in the reply.

en: "More accurate than Lady Urna, you say...?"{w}
"GWOAAAARGH! Those bastaaards!! They snatched it right out from under meeee!!{w}My... divine reliiiiic!!"{w}
note: oresama no = arrogant 'my'; the bluster comes through in the shouting.

en: "Stop making a disgrace of yourself, Donnelkral!"{w}
"...What is this racket?"{w}
